supported_domain.ncu_role: independent calibration/holdout target; never simulator input or timing fit

interpretation: C4-G sets an explicit observer-domain boundary from the C4-B positive controlled slice and C4-C/C4-D/C4-E/C4-F falsifiers. The project may report these slices as scoped observer evidence, but cannot claim broad hardware accuracy, semantic completion, or cross-family transfer. Further work returns to mechanism-local completion/native-continuation seams rather than silently widening this domain.
